summary.name: Token Tracker
summary.one_liner: A free, open-source, local-first dashboard that tracks AI coding tool token usage and cost across 47 tools, installed with one npx command.
keywords: track ai spend without sending prompts
use_cases: Compare token spend across multiple AI coding assistants
Find which model or project consumes the most tokens
Budget and report AI coding costs for a team
Check usage against subscription rate limits
Track usage trends by day, week, or month
summary.what_it_does: Token Tracker automatically detects installed AI coding tools on first run and installs the appropriate hooks or passive log readers for each. It normalizes provider-specific logs into half-hour UTC buckets keyed by source, model and time, and serves them from a local dashboard at localhost:7680. The dashboard shows input, output, cached and cache-creation tokens, per-model cost using an offline pricing snapshot covering 2,200+ models, project attribution, activity heatmaps and trend charts. It also displays usage limits for 18 providers and service status from eight provider status pages.
notable: Tracks 47 AI coding tools in one dashboard, including Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor, Gemini CLI and GitHub Copilot
Records token counts only; prompts and conversation content are not read or uploaded
Works offline; cloud sync is optional and only feeds the public leaderboard
Includes a desktop pet, four desktop widgets and achievements
caveats: Cloud sync is optional and powers only the public leaderboard
Native macOS and Windows apps are separate installs; the core dashboard runs via npx at localhost
Some readers depend on undocumented or internal provider formats (e.g. TRAE Work CN's internal API may change)
